heading: Authority of the arbitrator
lead: An arbitrator to whom a dispute is referred under this subchapter may—

tree.text: regulate the course of and conduct arbitral hearings;

compel the attendance of witnesses and production of evidence at the hearing under the provisions of section 7 of title 9 only to the extent the agency involved is otherwise authorized by law to do so; and

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1992—Pub. L. 102–354 renumbered section 588 of this title as this section.

ancestors.heading: ALTERNATIVE MEANS OF DISPUTE RESOLUTION IN THE ADMINISTRATIVE PROCESS
